name: POLARIS
fact: The North Star. Stays fixed while the sky rotates.

name: SIRIUS
fact: The Dog Star. Brightest star in the night sky.

name: BETELGEUSE
fact: Red Supergiant shoulder of Orion. Nearing end of life.

name: RIGEL
fact: Blue Supergiant foot of Orion. Extremely luminous.

name: BELLATRIX
fact: The Amazon Star. Left shoulder of the hunter.

name: ALNILAM
fact: The center star of Orion's Belt.

name: SAIPH
fact: The right knee of Orion.

name: DUBHE
fact: Pointer star to Polaris in the Big Dipper.

name: MERAK
fact: Part of the Big Dipper's bowl. Pointer to North.

name: PHECDA
fact: Bottom-left star of the Big Dipper's bowl.

name: MEGREZ
fact: The junction of the Big Dipper bowl and handle.

name: ALIOTH
fact: The brightest star in Ursa Major.

name: MIZAR
fact: Famous double star system in the handle.

name: ALKAID
fact: The end of the Big Dipper's handle.

name: VEGA
fact: Standard for 'zero' magnitude. Brightest star in Lyra.

name: ARCTURUS
fact: A red giant and the 4th brightest star in the sky.

name: ANTARES
fact: The Heart of the Scorpion. Often appears red.

name: DENEB
fact: Massive blue supergiant. Tail of the swan.

name: ALTAIR
fact: Rotates so fast it is flattened at its poles.

name: CAPELLA
fact: A complex system of 4 stars in two binary pairs.

name: SCHEDAR
fact: The peak of the 'W' shape in Cassiopeia.

name: CAPH
fact: A yellow-white giant star.

name: PROCYON
fact: The 'Lesser Dog Star'.

name: REGULUS
fact: The Heart of the Lion.

name: SPICA
fact: A binary star system and blue giant.
